title: Controller Ergonomics: Why Shape and Grip Matter for Long Sessions
summary: Hand cramping mid-match? Learn how ergonomic gaming controller design, grip shape, and weight distribution keep you comfortable through marathon sessions.
body_text: Hand cramping three hours into a session isn't a badge of honor. When your grip feels locked in place, and your thumbs are burning, that's your controller working against you. Poor ergonomic design doesn't just kill comfort - it tanks your performance when precision matters most. The shape of your controller and how it fits your hands determines whether you're pushing through pain or staying locked in. Ergonomic gaming controller design isn't about looking sleek. It's about reducing fatigue, maintaining control, and letting you play as long as you want without your hands staging a mutiny. What Makes a Controller Ergonomic Ergonomics is the science of designing equipment to fit the natural form and abilities of the human body. For gaming controllers, ergonomic design aims to increase efficiency and comfort while decreasing strain and fatigue. A well-designed form factor minimizes fatigue, enhances grip stability, and ensures that buttons, triggers, and sticks are within comfortable reach. Poor ergonomics leads to discomfort, reduced precision, and repetitive strain injuries over prolonged use. Key Ergonomic Features Controller grip design goes beyond surface-level texture. Weight distribution, palm support, and finger placement all factor into how your hands feel after hours of play. Controllers with poorly balanced weight or shallow grips force your hands into awkward positions, leading to cramping and reduced reaction times. Button placement matters just as much. Frequently used buttons should sit within easy reach of your thumbs and fingers, minimizing strain and awkward stretches. Shape and contour define how a controller sits in your palm. Curvy designs provide natural finger positioning but can limit the range of hand sizes that use a controller comfortably. How the Controller Shape Affects Your Grip Comfortable gamepad shape determines whether you're adapting to your controller or your controller is adapting to you. The naturalness of a controller's shape, its weight, and the ability to reach functions without changing grip all impact ergonomic quality. Most players use one of three grip styles: palm grip, claw grip, or fingertip grip. Palm grip distributes controller weight across your entire hand, reducing pressure on any single point. Claw grip offers better control and faster button presses, but taxes your fingers more. Controllers with adjustable features or modular components let you find your natural hold without fighting the hardware. A controller that's front-heavy or back-heavy forces constant micro-adjustments in your grip, leading to hand fatigue. Optimal weight distribution keeps the controller balanced in your hands, allowing relaxed grip pressure without sacrificing control. Controllers should weigh under 300 grams for optimal comfort during extended sessions. Why Long-Session Gaming Controllers Need Better Design Marathon gaming sessions expose every ergonomic flaw. What feels fine for 30 minutes becomes painful after three hours. Research shows that ergonomic controller features significantly reduce fatigue and allow users to play for long hours, preventing gaming injuries. Hand fatigue during long sessions isn't just uncomfortable - it's a performance killer. When your hands tire, your reaction times slow, your aim suffers, and you start making mistakes you normally wouldn't. An ergonomic controller maintains consistent comfort and performance from the first match to the last. Common Controller Problems Controllers with shallow grips or narrow handles cause your hands to slide during play, forcing constant readjustment. Controllers with poor button placement make you stretch or contort your fingers to reach essential inputs. Small controllers work great for portability, but fall short during long sessions. Their flat, narrow shape doesn't support a natural grip, leading to hand cramps for players with larger hands. Turtle Beach Ergonomic Solutions Modern Turtle Beach controllers address these issues with thoughtful ergonomic design, adjustable features, and comfort-focused engineering. Stealth Ultra Controller The Stealth Ultra Controller features programmable back buttons and Hall Effect analog sticks that reduce the effort required for actions, making gameplay smoother. Its Connected Command Display eliminates menu navigation mid-game, keeping hands in an optimal position. Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded Wireless Controller takes modularity further with 11 interchangeable parts that customize to your exact grip style and hand size. Four programmable paddle buttons reduce thumb movement, while balanced weight maintains comfort during extended sessions. Rematch Series Controllers For budget-conscious gamers, the Rematch Advanced Wired Controller and Rematch Core Wired Controller provide ergonomic design at accessible price points with textured grips and balanced weight distribution. Victrix Gambit Prime Wired Controller The Victrix Gambit Prime Wired Controller delivers professional-grade ergonomics with responsive microswitches designed for competitive play without sacrificing comfort. Building Your Complete Gaming Setup Consider how controller ergonomics fit into your broader gaming environment. Your ultimate couch gaming setup should prioritize comfort across all peripherals. For specialized gaming, Victrix Pro KO elevates your fighting game performance with an ergonomic design that supports frame-perfect inputs. Understanding leverless vs traditional fight sticks competitive play helps competitive players choose ergonomic setups. The buying guide for trending gaming gifts can help identify ergonomic controllers and audio combinations for comfortable gaming experiences. Choosing the Right Controller for Your Hands The right ergonomic gaming controller fits your hands, not the other way around. Consider your hand size, grip style, and the types of games you play most often. Shooters demand different ergonomics than fighting games or racing sims. Test how a controller feels before committing to marathon sessions. Check whether you can reach all buttons without shifting your grip. Verify that the weight feels balanced and the grips support your palms without forcing awkward angles. Controllers with modular or adjustable features accommodate different hand sizes and preferences, minimizing the need to adapt to designs that don't fit naturally. FAQ What is an ergonomic gaming controller? An ergonomic gaming controller is designed to reduce stress on your hands, wrists, and arms during play. These controllers feature shapes, grips, and button layouts that fit natural hand positions, minimizing fatigue and strain during extended sessions. How do I know if my controller is causing hand fatigue? If you experience cramping, numbness, or soreness in your hands, wrists, or forearms during or after gaming sessions, your controller likely has ergonomic issues. Pay attention to whether you're constantly readjusting your grip or if certain buttons feel difficult to reach. Does controller shape really matter for performance? Absolutely. Comfortable gamepad shape directly impacts performance by reducing fatigue and maintaining consistent control. When your hands are comfortable, you maintain better precision, faster reaction times, and fewer mistakes during crucial moments. What features should I look for in a long session gaming controller? Prioritize balanced weight distribution under 300 grams, adjustable or modular components for customization, textured grips for secure hold, and button placement that doesn't require grip changes. Controllers with programmable back buttons reduce the need to move your thumbs from the sticks.

title: How Glimpse Grew 10X in 2025
summary: Glimpse 10x'd revenue in 2025 by solving consumer brands' deduction problems with AI agents. Learn how we expanded from KeHE/UNFI to Target, Walmart, and Amazon, processing $1B+ in invoices and recovering thousands automatically—no human involvement required.
body_text: Glimpse Had a Busy 2025 When Kushal, Anuj, and I launched Glimpse in April 2024, we set out with a simple mission. Help consumer brands stop losing up to 5 percent of their retail revenue to invalid deductions. If you talk to any operator inside a consumer goods brand, you will hear the same story. Deductions are an extremely painful & deeply emotional pain point. It is revenue they have already lost as a result of opaque accounting processes, manual workflows, and embedded retailer complexity. For a startup, this problem created an extremely clear ROI. We always saw it as the perfect wedge into a much broader vision. Unlocking retail cashflow using AI agents. 2025 became the year that vision started to compound. We ended the year by 10x’ing the business. But behind that headline is the real story. The work, decisions, and product breakthroughs that made this rate of growth possible. How We Entered 2025 We started the year with early momentum supporting brands selling through KeHE and UNFI. That gave us two things: Proof of value - we quickly found a painful problem in deductions we could meaningfully solve for our customers. Customer Insight - we started to understand how cash and costs from retail channels affect scaling brands. Coming off our $10 million dollar raise led by 8VC, we saw a unique window in 2025 to hit escape velocity by doing two things extremely well. Delivering undeniable value and expanding the platform in the direction our customers were already pulling us. Our ethos going into the year was simple. 1. Hire excellent people & work together in person People who are extremely hard working, curious, and collaborative. Work in person. Move fast. Sweat the details. Build together. 2. Embed ourselves deeply inside customer workflows We wanted to deeply understand where labor was inefficient and where AI could provide 10X value. 3. Be opinionated in our GTM approach For us, we bet on IRL. Build a community & bring operators together. Our internal tagline “Be everywhere”. Build trust by showing up consistently & being helpful. This framework shaped everything we did and it worked. What We Achieved in 2025 Here is what that strategy produced. 10x increase in revenue recovered for clients. Direct bottom line impact. 5x growth in invoice volume processed , now crossing 1 billion dollars. 5x headcount growth , now 25 plus world class people in NYC. 3x increase in total clients , reaching 150 plus consumer brands. And most importantly, we delivered a major expansion of our platform capabilities in four major ways. End to end revenue recovery Across 6 Plus Retailers We moved beyond KeHE and UNFI into Target, Walmart, Amazon, Sam's Club, and several others. This unlocked new brand categories, new data flows, and new ways to support brands across their entire retail footprint. AI Revenue Recovery Agents This was one of the most ambitious things we have ever built. We launched fully end to end AI agents that handle: Deduction retrieval Coding Validation using internal documentation Filing of claims Brands can now recover thousands of dollars with no human involvement. This shifted what revenue recovery can even mean. ‍ Automated Cash Application Finance teams spend hours dealing with messy data, obscure invoice codes, and manual mapping inside their GL and ERP. We automated this entire flow. Parse and understand retailer remittance data Classify and map deductions Sync information back to the ERP Cut hours out of month end close This was one of the most painful workflows in the month end close process and now it is one of the most automated. AI Deduction Itemization Every deduction includes backup documentation. Often the documents are more than 100 pages long and filled with mixed retailers, SKUs, brokers, and unstructured details. Most brands do not use this data. Not because it is not valuable, but because it has been impossible to process manually at scale. We launched AI deduction itemization to extract every relevant detail into a structured, tabular format. This unlocks a new level of intelligence. Broker commissions with accurate data Profitability by retailer Trade analytics Promotion performance Margin improvement strategies This is foundational for the future of retail cashflow automation. Looking Ahead 2025 was a transformative year for Glimpse. We proved not only that the market is massive, but that AI agents for the first time ever can unlock cashflow and help consumer brands scale And we are just getting started. 2026 will be the year we scale these capabilities, deepen automation across the entire retail revenue cycle, and continue building the platform consumer brands trust to unlock their cashflow.

summary: Learn how to pick the perfect Turtle Beach gaming mouse for your playstyle. Compare features, comfort, and sensors to level up your game.
body_text: Precision, comfort, and responsiveness define every great gaming experience. A good gaming mouse gives you control that matches your reflexes and comfort for long sessions. The right choice depends on your hand size, playstyle, and preferred game type. Turtle Beach designs its mice to meet each of these needs with precision technology and durable design. Understanding What Makes a Great Gaming Mouse When shopping for the best gaming mouse in 2025, focus on the essentials that actually affect performance: Sensor and DPI range: Determines how precisely the mouse tracks movement. Polling rate: Measures how frequently the mouse communicates with your system. Weight and ergonomics: Lighter models enhance speed; ergonomic ones improve comfort. Customization: Programmable buttons and adjustable lighting help you tailor gameplay. Connection type: Choose between wired precision or wireless freedom. These are the benchmarks Turtle Beach follows in its gaming peripherals. Shop the bestseller lineup now and grab the hottest deals while they last! Turtle Beach Burst II Air – $59.99 A wireless lightweight gaming mouse at only 47g, the Burst II Air focuses on speed, balance, and freedom. It features the Owl-Eye 26K sensor and up to 120 hours of Bluetooth battery life. The shape suits fingertip or claw grips, making it ideal for FPS players who rely on fast, consistent motion. Making Sense of DPI and Sensors DPI controls how far the cursor moves per inch of hand motion. The higher the DPI, the faster the on-screen movement. However, stability matters more than raw speed. Turtle Beach’s Owl-Eye sensors (rated up to 30,000 DPI) track precisely, even at high speeds, offering accurate motion on both cloth and hard surfaces. Use a lower DPI (400–1200) for first-person shooters to maintain control. Use higher DPI (2000–4000) for RTS or creative applications. Adjust DPI levels in Turtle Beach’s Swarm II software, which allows easy sensitivity switching mid-game. Customization and Control The Swarm II software lets users fine-tune performance, lighting, and macros. You can remap buttons, adjust lift-off distance, or create custom profiles for different games. The Kone II Air’s Easy-Shift[+] system effectively doubles button functionality, while the Burst II Pro’s onboard memory stores up to five profiles. Pairing these with Turtle Beach’s Vulcan II keyboards and Stealth headsets builds a seamless ecosystem synced through one software suite. Wired vs Wireless Performance Both wireless and wired models perform nearly identically today. Turtle Beach’s low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless technology offers millisecond response times, while Bluetooth adds convenience for everyday use. Gamers needing the most consistent responsiveness can opt for the Burst II Pro’s wired connection. Wireless users will appreciate the long battery life of the Kone II Air (up to 350 hours). Ergonomics and Comfort Hand size and grip preference are crucial. Small/medium hands: Burst II Air offers fast handling and minimal fatigue. Medium/large hands: Kone II Air provides a fuller grip for long play sessions. Whichever you choose, Turtle Beach ensures lightweight builds and smooth-glide feet for long-term comfort. Setting Up for Best Performance Install Swarm II to manage DPI, profiles, and RGB. Set DPI based on your in-game sensitivity. Adjust polling rate to 1000 Hz or higher for esports titles. Save separate profiles for FPS, RPG, and editing apps. Keep firmware updated for performance enhancements. For an even better experience, match your mouse with Turtle Beach’s precision hardware: Controllers for console play. Keyboards for customization. Headsets for immersive sound. Grab Black Friday Deals While They Last FAQ What makes Turtle Beach gaming mice different from others? Turtle Beach gaming mice stand out for their balance of advanced technology and ergonomic design. Each model features the Owl-Eye optical sensor for unmatched accuracy and customizable DPI settings to match your gameplay style. Dual wireless modes, high polling rates, and integration with Turtle Beach’s Swarm II software make them reliable for both casual and esports-level gaming. Combined with premium build quality and smart button layouts, they’re designed to perform under pressure without sacrificing comfort. How do I choose the right DPI for my gaming mouse? DPI determines how far your cursor moves for every inch of physical mouse movement. A lower DPI (400–800) works well for precision-based games like Call of Duty or Valorant, while higher DPI levels (2000–4000) suit creative workflows or faster genres like RTS. Turtle Beach’s Swarm II software lets you create multiple DPI profiles so you can switch seamlessly between play styles. The key is to test sensitivity across different games until your movements feel smooth and instinctive. Are wireless gaming mice as responsive as wired ones? Yes, especially with Turtle Beach’s 2.4 GHz low-latency wireless technology. Models like the Burst II Air and Kone II Air deliver response times virtually identical to wired setups, giving you freedom without lag. Dual connectivity (Bluetooth and 2.4 GHz) ensures versatility whether you’re gaming on PC, console, or laptop. For tournaments or marathon sessions, you can always switch to wired mode for consistent power and uninterrupted play. What customization can I expect from Turtle Beach gaming mice? Turtle Beach gaming mice offer deep customization options through the Swarm II software suite. You can remap buttons, set up macros, and adjust lighting zones to suit each game profile. The Kone II Air, for instance, supports up to 21 programmable functions via Easy-Shift[+] technology, effectively doubling your control options. Even lighting effects can be synchronized with Turtle Beach headsets or keyboards for a unified setup that feels uniquely yours. How long does the battery last on Turtle Beach wireless mice? Battery life depends on the model and mode used. The Kone II Air delivers up to 350 hours via Bluetooth and around 130 hours through 2.4 GHz wireless, making it ideal for extended sessions. The Burst II Air provides around 120 hours of Bluetooth runtime while staying ultra-light for fast-paced gaming. Both can also connect via USB-C, allowing play and charge simultaneously, so you never lose power mid-match.

title: Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. Advances Its Plastics Recycling Facility with Alterra Energy’s Technology Platform

body_text: Abundia advances its licensing agreement by delivering site notification to Alterra Energy for the deployment of its plastics liquefactions technology at Abundia’s Cedar Port Renewable Energy Complex HOUSTON, TX, Dec. 09, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. (NYSE American: AGIG) (“Abundia” or the “Company”), today announced that it has progressed in its licensing agreement with Alterra Energy (“Alterra”) towards the development of a technology and commercialization platform to convert discarded plastic into renewable fuels and chemical products. Following the critical step of solidifying the project’s infrastructure with the recent acquisition of the Baytown Site in Texas, its Cedar Port Innovation Center, Abundia has officially delivered site notification to Alterra to commence the technology design process. Through extensive operations at Alterra’s commercial facility, the technology platform has demonstrated strong and consistent performance across a broad range of post-consumer plastic feedstocks. Alterra’s fully continuous, catalyst-free reactor and process design using standard industrial equipment has proven its robustness by delivering high liquid yields and stable product quality that meets the requirements of downstream processors. Historically, Alterra’s technology and process designs have successfully manufactured a commercial grade liquified product that aligns with Abundia’s business focus of turning waste into high-value renewable fuels and chemical products. “We have made significant strides in the transformation of our business with a view to becoming one of the largest producers of sustainable fuels and energy transition technologies. Advancing our licensing agreement with Alterra is a critical next step for the Company,” stated Ed Gillespie, Abundia Chief Executive Officer. “We have worked diligently to get to this point, and we are excited to commence the process with Alterra in the buildout of Abundia’s first commercial plant. We have confidence that Alterra delivers an industry “best in class” platform, and we look forward to working with the Alterra team to bring this project to final development.” “Abundia’s confidence in our renewables focused technology and its vision for advancing circular solutions is a major step forward in “Solving Plastic Pollution®,” said Fred Schmuck, Alterra Chief Executive Officer. “We are honored to partner with Abundia as it pursues this pivotal project.” About Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. Abundia Global Impact Group, Inc. (NYSE American: AGIG), formerly Houston American Energy Corp., is a low-carbon energy company focused on converting waste into value. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, we are developing commercial-scale facilities that transform waste plastics and biomass into drop-in fuels and low-carbon chemical feedstocks. Our flagship project at Cedar Port positions Abundia at the center of the Gulf Coast’s energy and chemical infrastructure, with access to feedstock supply chains, upgrading partners, and end markets. title: C3 AI Achieves FedRAMP Authorization
summary: The C3 AI FedRAMP authorization lets agencies apply secure, proven Enterprise AI to protected, high-impact government use cases. Read the announcement.
body_text: Agencies can now leverage C3 AI’s secure, proven Enterprise AI technology for protected, high-impact government use cases REDWOOD CITY, Calif. — December 11, 2025 — C3 AI (NYSE: AI), the Enterprise AI software company, today announced it achieved FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program) authorization. FedRAMP is the U.S. government’s standardized framework for validating the security of cloud platforms that process sensitive, data-heavy workloads, enabling agencies to adopt advanced cloud and AI capabilities with speed and confidence. “Obtaining FedRAMP authorization underlines that the C3 Agentic AI Platform is trusted, secure and compliant with the stringent standards that federal agencies demand,” said Stephen Ehikian, CEO, C3 AI. “We’re proud to deliver to government customers the same Enterprise AI capabilities used by commercial enterprises — now with full federal-grade accreditation.” C3 AI’s FedRAMP Moderate designation builds on the company’s existing IL5 and IL6 authorizations as C3 AI expands its support for the federal government. With this authorization, C3 AI is listed on the FedRAMP Marketplace and is deemed authorized for use by federal agencies — accelerating the ability to adopt proven AI-driven solutions across mission-critical programs. About C3 AI C3 AI is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise.
